name: ouro-butler
description: Mendelow Cloud Butler is a friendly Telegram steward for an Unraid household. It turns system evidence into useful agent-owned help, keeps each family member private, and asks before consequential actions.

paths.name: Privileged event spool
paths.description: Root-owned detector envelopes, read-only inside the Butler

paths.name: Root authority socket
paths.description: Root-owned gateway socket and public issuer pins only

paths.name: Psyche (read-only)
paths.description: The Butler's psyche files, read-only inside the Butler so they can be neither edited nor replaced

paths.name: Operator trust (read-only)
paths.description: Root-owned grants the Butler honours (delegated commands, escalation). Read-only inside the Butler; only the host operator can change it
